# Nia Media

> Nia Media produces professional video commercials, promo posters, jingles, and AI-powered marketing campaigns for small and medium businesses in Kenya and East Africa. Based in Nairobi. Payments via M-Pesa, Visa, and Mastercard (PesaPal).

## Services and pricing (KES)

- Video commercials: 15s from 3,500 · 30s from 5,000 · 60s from 7,500 · 90s from 12,000 · 3min+ infomercials from 25,000. Standard delivery 3–5 business days; 48-hour (+25%) and 24-hour (+50%) rush available. Full exclusive rights on delivery. Optimised for TikTok, Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook, YouTube.
- Promo posters and AI campaign copy: from KES 500 — social captions, WhatsApp broadcast messages, video scripts, and poster copy in English or Kiswahili. Free demo available on the homepage, no account required.
- Jingles and voice overs: from KES 1,500 — radio-ready jingles and professional African voice overs.
